description: Detail list for membership summary click-through.
name: Members in Category - Selected Year

stages.native:
WITH current_rows AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS raw_member_id,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name")) AS member_name,
    lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', m."First name", m."Last name"))) AS name_key,
    NULLIF(lower(trim(COALESCE(m."Email address", ''))), '') AS email_key,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."Venue ID", '')), '') AS venue_id,
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(m."British Tennis Number", '')), '') AS btn,
    m."Membership" AS membership,
    p.category,
    p.display_order,
    COALESCE(m."Cost", 0) AS member_cost,
    m."Payment" AS payment,
    m."Status" AS status,
    m."Email address" AS email_address,
    m."Phone number" AS phone_number,
    m."Mobile number" AS mobile_number,
    m."Postcode" AS postcode
  FROM public.raw_members m
  JOIN public.membership_packages p
    ON m."Membership" = p.name
   AND p.season = {{year}}::text
  WHERE p.category NOT IN ('Pavilion Key', 'Honorary')
    AND m."Status" = 'Active'
),
current_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key))
    COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key) AS dedupe_key,
    raw_member_id,
    member_name,
    name_key,
    email_key,
    venue_id,
    btn,
    membership,
    category,
    display_order,
    payment,
    status,
    email_address,
    phone_number,
    mobile_number,
    postcode
  FROM current_rows
  ORDER BY COALESCE(email_key, venue_id, btn, name_key), member_cost DESC, raw_member_id DESC, display_order, membership
)
SELECT
  member_name,
  category,
  membership AS "Membership",
  payment AS "Payment",
  status AS "Status",
  email_address AS "Email address",
  phone_number AS "Phone number",
  mobile_number AS "Mobile number",
  postcode AS "Postcode"
FROM current_best
WHERE category = {{category}}
ORDER BY split_part(member_name, ' ', array_length(string_to_array(member_name, ' '), 1)), member_name;
